name: Ankylosing Spondylitis Flow
description: A gentle extension and rib-mobility program to counteract spinal stiffening patterns, with hip opening and thoracic expansion.
goal: Maintain spinal extension and chest mobility.

name: Arthritis-Gentle Flow
description: A warm, fluid movement session that reduces joint stiffness, builds gentle synovial circulation, and maintains comfortable range of motion.
goal: Ease joint stiffness and maintain comfortable range of motion.

name: Back-Friendly Recovery
description: A low-impact session designed to support the low back with neutral spine strength, gentle articulation, and pelvic control.
goal: Improve back stability and reduce compressive stress.

name: Balance & Vestibular Stability
description: A ground-based proprioception and vestibular adaptation program for dizziness, vertigo, and fall risk — minimising sudden head position changes and prioritising stability.
goal: Improve balance, proprioception, and fall prevention.

name: Beginner Mat Foundation
description: A gentle introductory Pilates session focused on core support, spinal articulation, and breath coordination.
goal: Build stable core and mat movement confidence.

name: Cardiac-Safe Flow
description: A breath-regulated, moderate-intensity session for hypertension, cardiovascular disease, and cardiac device users — avoiding Valsalva and extremes of exertion.
goal: Support cardiovascular health with safe, breath-led movement.

name: Cervical & Neck Care
description: A cervical-decompression sequence with scapular stability and thoracic opening to relieve neck load and improve upper-body alignment.
goal: Reduce cervical compression and improve neck posture.

name: Chronic Pain & Fibromyalgia
description: A pain-paced, graded movement program for fibromyalgia and chronic pain syndrome — using central sensitisation principles to build movement tolerance gently.
goal: Build gentle movement tolerance with pain-pacing principles.

name: Disc & Sciatica Relief
description: A neutral-spine session that combines lumbar decompression, gentle neural mobility, and graduated core loading for disc and sciatic pain.
goal: Reduce disc compression and sciatic nerve tension.

name: Epilepsy Ground-Safe Flow
description: A ground-based mat program for epilepsy and seizure disorders — staying low, avoiding inversions and breath-holding, with calm pacing throughout.
goal: Exercise safely with epilepsy using a ground-based, inversion-free sequence.

name: Foot & Ankle Rehabilitation
description: An intrinsic foot and ankle strengthening sequence addressing plantar loading, Achilles resilience, and foot alignment for common lower-limb conditions.
goal: Strengthen foot intrinsics and restore ankle stability.

name: Hip & Lateral Chain Recovery
description: A glute and lateral hip strengthening program addressing piriformis, hamstring, IT band, and greater trochanteric pain with targeted spring and mat work.
goal: Strengthen the lateral hip chain and relieve hip and thigh pain.

name: Hip Mobility & Recovery
description: A hip mobility program that respects impingement-free ranges, builds lateral hip stability, and restores functional movement patterns.
goal: Restore hip mobility and strengthen lateral stabilisers.

name: Hypermobility Control
description: A joint-stabilisation program that builds neuromuscular control and end-range awareness, replacing passive flexibility with active strength.
goal: Develop active joint stability and neuromuscular control.

name: Joint Replacement Recovery
description: A post-surgical mobility restoration program using gentle range-of-motion work, non-impact loading, and progressive movement confidence.
goal: Restore mobility and confidence after joint replacement or surgery.

name: Knee Rehabilitation
description: A VMO and quad-activation sequence using non-weight-bearing leg work and spring resistance to support knee recovery and prevent re-injury.
goal: Restore knee stability and quad control after injury or surgery.

name: Metabolic Whole-Body Flow
description: A progressive whole-body activation sequence for diabetes, metabolic conditions, and weight management — prioritising circulation, functional strength, and energy expenditure.
goal: Activate metabolism and build functional full-body strength.

name: Mind-Body Calm
description: A breath-led somatic flow for anxiety, mental health conditions, and recovery — using rhythm, grounding, and interoceptive awareness to calm the nervous system.
goal: Calm the nervous system through breath-led somatic movement.

name: Neurological Movement Flow
description: A coordination and proprioception-focused program for MS, Parkinson's, and neurological conditions — using rhythmic, predictable sequences to support motor control.
goal: Improve motor coordination and neuromuscular rhythm.

name: Osteoporosis-Safe Flow
description: An extension-focused sequence that avoids loaded spinal flexion and rotation, building axial strength and posture with bone-friendly loading.
goal: Strengthen posture and support bone density safely.

name: Pelvic Floor Foundations
description: A pressure-management program for pelvic floor dysfunction, diastasis recti, hernia, and incontinence — building deep core reconnection without excessive intra-abdominal load.
goal: Reconnect deep core and pelvic floor with load management.

name: Postpartum Recovery Flow
description: A gentle Pilates sequence designed to support postpartum core rebuilding, pelvic floor awareness, and gradual abdominal return.
goal: Rebuild core support and pelvic stability after pregnancy.

name: Prenatal Mobility Flow
description: A pregnancy-safe Pilates flow that supports the changing body with gentle spinal mobility and lateral openness.
goal: Maintain mobility and core support during pregnancy.

name: Reformer Strength Flow
description: An apparatus-based routine that develops lower-body control, carriage coordination, and spinal support.
goal: Build Reformer strength and control.

name: Respiratory & Breath Flow
description: A diaphragmatic breathing and ribcage expansion program to improve thoracic mobility and breathing mechanics in respiratory and pulmonary conditions.
goal: Expand breathing capacity and thoracic mobility.

name: Rotator Cuff & Shoulder Rehab
description: A scapular-first shoulder rehabilitation sequence targeting rotator cuff activation, pendular range of motion, and progressive loading for frozen shoulder, impingement, and AC sprains.
goal: Restore rotator cuff strength and pain-free shoulder range.

name: Restorative Immune Support
description: A gentle, energy-conserving program for chronic fatigue, autoimmune conditions, oncology treatment, and immunosuppression — honouring capacity limits with restorative movement.
goal: Support recovery and energy with gentle restorative movement.

name: Sacroiliac Stability
description: A pelvic stability program targeting symmetric hip loading, SIJ compression control, and deep lumbopelvic muscle recruitment.
goal: Stabilise the sacroiliac joint and pelvic girdle.

name: Scoliosis Balance Flow
description: A laterally balanced session using derotational cues, lateral breathing, and symmetry-focused movement to support the scoliotic spine.
goal: Balance lateral asymmetry and improve spinal awareness.

name: Sensory-Adapted Flow
description: A proprioceptively-rich, predictable Pilates sequence designed for vision and hearing impairment — using spatial consistency, tactile cueing, and safe orientation.
goal: Move safely and confidently with sensory impairment.

name: Shoulder-Friendly Flow
description: A focused session for shoulder comfort that emphasizes scapular support, gentle upper-body strength, and safe range of motion.
goal: Support shoulder stability with safe Pilates movement.

name: Upper Limb & Nerve Relief
description: A thoracic-opening and neural-mobilisation flow for wrist, elbow, and nerve compression conditions — keeping joint loading low and range of motion wide.
goal: Decompress nerves and restore thoracic and upper-limb mobility.
